scope: Accessible August–October 2026 Library and linked research archive; selected papers are predominantly September–October. Complete publication-priority review remains pending.

entries.title: Erdős minimum overlap
entries.summary: 131,072-cell rational upper-bound witness with an internally replayed all-shift score of 0.380856370118029325…; external specialist audit remains open.
entries.boundary: An explicit construction and its exact audit; separate from the accepted Arena entry.

entries.title: Sidon (4,5): 30-point witness
entries.summary: A 30-integer configuration whose largest Sidon subset contains 17 elements, with an exhaustive finite checker.
entries.boundary: A distinct finite witness; existing asymptotic results remain credited to prior researchers.

entries.title: Fourth-power finite-field reconstruction
entries.summary: Fourth-power sensing and LLL reconstruction up to a root-of-unity ambiguity, with a systematic decoder manuscript and finite tests.
entries.boundary: The public handoff is an excerpt; quantified all-signal event, full decoder and mathematical priority require independent audit.

entries.title: Nonabelian involution-shadow codes
entries.summary: Finite-group shadow encodings with exact distance, pair-spectrum and balanced erasure-allocation formulas, including nonabelian test cases.
entries.boundary: Algebraic manuscript and finite checks; formal-kernel verification and worldwide novelty audit still open.

entries.title: Periodic forest-gauge obstruction
entries.summary: A periodic four-dimensional combinatorial defect identity, accompanied by a separate integer checker.
entries.boundary: Thirty-two representative finite checks reproduce the identity; universal proof and priority still require outside review.

entries.title: Affine source rigidity
entries.summary: September work on affine source collisions, shifted prime-series expansions, and rational dilation fibers.
entries.boundary: Analytic assumptions and originality remain under review.

entries.title: Factor-network compilation
entries.summary: A checked factor-network equality compiler with explicit structural certificates.
entries.boundary: Compiler behavior is reproducible; COPY tensors and factor-graph compilation are known constructions.

entries.title: ETH Hermite taper and rank barrier
entries.summary: An interpolation precision allowance improvement and a lower bound for restricted disjoint middle-layer refinements.
entries.boundary: A restricted obstruction result, with no claimed new SAT worst-case exponent.

entries.title: Selection-aware Gaussian pivoting
entries.summary: A selected-row Gaussian spectral-tail analysis that retains triangular elimination loss.
entries.boundary: The final matrix-growth-factor improvement remains open.

entries.title: Finite-field span-tail reduction
entries.summary: Independent exact checkers establish a 2⁻⁹⁶ arithmetic tail envelope for stated large-field parameters under a span-count hypothesis.
entries.boundary: The central Gaussian short-vector span-count lemma and end-to-end decoder guarantee are unverified; arithmetic checks remain conditional.

entries.title: Heterogeneous erasure complexity
entries.summary: Shadow-code erasure reliability under correlated and heterogeneous losses, with a two-class dynamic program and complexity reduction.
entries.boundary: Several complexity and allocation principles predate this construction; only the scope-matched synthesis is under novelty review.

entries.title: Werner 24–25-copy rational certificates
entries.summary: Exact-rational downstream certificates report qutrit thresholds 0.34636 at 24 copies and 0.34584 at 25 copies under lower-copy theorems.
entries.boundary: Distinct from the approved 4–20 registry; original quantitative source inequalities and full scope still require outside replay.

entries.title: Werner correlated-spectator certificates
entries.summary: A separable correlated-spectator transfer yields 6-, 7-, and 8-copy conditional candidates 0.448760, 0.432280 and 0.419900.
entries.boundary: Historical higher bounds import quantitative source-SDP assumptions, whose witness replay and lineage reconciliation remain open.

entries.title: Werner finite-copy evidence atlas
entries.summary: Separates 4–20 qutrit and all-dimension thresholds, reported 21–24 improvements and symbolic 25–100 continuation.
entries.boundary: Historic 6–9 alternatives and imported 4-/5-copy SDP margins remain separate until original source witnesses are independently checked.

entries.title: Nine-word affine-code endpoint
entries.summary: A four-copy qutrit code supports an explicit trace-inequality decomposition certifying endpoint positivity on a nine-dimensional Alice range.
entries.boundary: Restricted witnesses only; this public digest summarizes a Library manuscript, whose frozen source ZIP still needs a public mirror.

entries.title: Complementary-syndrome gluing
entries.summary: A syndrome-difference selection rule extends the affine-code theorem to coherent rank-two witnesses on 27×27 supports.
entries.boundary: Colliding syndrome differences create cross terms; the original source PDF and checker archive are separate from this curated digest.

entries.title: Werner 4,209-dimensional witness lift
entries.summary: An internally audited spectral extension enlarges the 729-dimensional syndrome rectangle to a 4,209-dimensional linear support.
entries.boundary: Linear dimension is not rank-two coverage; endpoint positivity remains restricted and original-priority review is outstanding.

entries.title: Sharp Werner cross-syndrome coupling
entries.summary: The exact off-sector norm 1/√2 supports a rank-two-safe positivity criterion reaching beyond the original linear witness space.
entries.boundary: The norm is already saturated by a rank-one example; no unrestricted four-copy positivity theorem follows.

entries.title: Ternary diagonal rigidity obstruction
entries.summary: A Hamming-parity and symplectic argument bounds positive diagonal coordinate supports by 2ᵏ and classifies the binary-cube extremizers.
entries.boundary: An ambient diagonal-subspace obstruction, not a claim of unrestricted rank-two positivity; outside novelty review remains open.

entries.title: Agent Safety Under Abstraction
entries.summary: A September analysis of observation fibers, collateral-denial effects, provenance composition, and agent-side information limits.
entries.boundary: Classical factorization results are identified; stronger authority claims require proof and priority review.

entries.title: AI safety theorem-and-evidence series
entries.summary: An integrated September–October account of observation sufficiency, authority, oversight, and adversarial provenance.
entries.boundary: Distinguishes finite checks and manuscript dependencies from independently established new guarantees.

entries.title: SourceBound evidence prototype
entries.summary: An implementation track for source admission, claim provenance, and evidence-aware responses.
entries.boundary: Natural-web controlled effectiveness remains an open evaluation; overlapping prior products are credited.

entries.title: Counterfactual authorization gap
entries.summary: Formal models of reference-class capability envelopes, audit burden, and composition-induced escape.
entries.boundary: The status is a theoretical manuscript requiring external proof and priority review.

entries.title: Three ceilings on oversight
entries.summary: A synthesis of information, computational, and evidence-authority limits in AI oversight.
entries.boundary: Each claim has an assumption-specific scope; general systems efficacy is untested.

entries.title: Hidden-function interpretability
entries.summary: Paired observational and causal residual checks, an exact small-state demonstration, and a blinded evaluation design.
entries.boundary: The example is limited in scale; empirical generalization awaits controlled tests.

entries.title: Causal cuts and research selection
entries.summary: Directed-cut factorization, evaluation transport, and obstruction-pair reasoning for decision-oriented research.
entries.boundary: The finite algebraic examples and synthetic studies carry no general causal discovery theorem.

entries.title: Proof After Scarcity
entries.summary: The archived 20-case ranking study produced 8/20 versus an upstream-first 11/20 baseline.
entries.boundary: An informative bounded negative outcome; no claimed general superiority.

entries.title: NIGHTFALL Discovery Engine
entries.summary: Reproducible search contracts, representation changes, exact replay, falsification controls, and adaptive-resolution experiments.
entries.boundary: Prototype and synthetic evidence; domain-wide improvements await held-out, matched-budget evaluation.

entries.title: Competition and negative-result registry
entries.summary: Erdős, C1/C2, UP25, rejected submissions, provenance conflicts, and unsuccessful operators in one evidence-aware chronology.
entries.boundary: Leaderboard standing, mathematical validity, and source completeness are tracked separately.

entries.title: Adaptive-resolution research architecture
entries.summary: Reversible multiscale representations and counterexample-sensitive segmentation with preserved source hashes and a tested non-ML prototype.
entries.boundary: A trained selector, cross-domain efficiency improvements and held-out matched-budget trials remain future work.
